description_en: Queries the details of a 5G message persistent menu by a specified version
description_zh: 指定版本查看5G消息固定菜单详情
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi query-rcs-sign-menu-by-version --sign-name '阿里云' --rcs-menu-version RCS_MENU_123410123 --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryRcsSignMenuByVersion

parameters.help_en:
The menu version.

Only the most recently submitted version and versions that are partially or fully effective can be queried
parameters.help_zh:
菜单版本。

仅支持查询最近一次提交的版本，以及处于部分生效/全部生效的版本
parameters.name: rcs_menu_version

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details returned when access is denied
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝时返回的详细信息

Code.description_en: The request status code. OK indicates that the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 请求状态码。返回OK代表请求成功

Data.description_en: The returned data, which contains `MenuContent` (the menu content in JSON format)
Data.description_zh: 返回数据，包含`MenuContent`（菜单内容，JSON格式）

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
